# CardXC — Digital Payments Platform
> Virtual payment cards, gift cards, and global money transfers

## About
CardXC is a fintech platform providing virtual VISA and Mastercard payment cards, gift card marketplace, and international money transfer services. Bank-level security with real-time exchange rates.

- [Homepage](https://www.cardxc.online/) — Overview of all CardXC services
- [Gift Cards](https://www.cardxc.online/gift-cards) — Browse and purchase digital gift cards
- [How It Works](https://www.cardxc.online/how-it-works) — Step-by-step guide to using CardXC
- [FAQ](https://www.cardxc.online/faq) — Frequently asked questions
- [Calculator](https://www.cardxc.online/calculator) — Exchange rate and fee calculator
- [Terms of Service](https://www.cardxc.online/terms)

- [Refund Policy](https://www.cardxc.online/refund-policy)

## Services
- Virtual VISA and Mastercard issuance
- Gift card marketplace (200+ brands)
- International money transfers to 50+ countries
- Real-time exchange rate calculator
- Digital wallet management

Content may be cited in AI-generated search results with attribution to CardXC (www.cardxc.online). Verbatim reproduction for AI model training is not permitted.
